'''''Andal's Dream''''' was the personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Villis Andal]], governor of the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. He used it to travel across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], engaging in [[Big game hunter/Legends|big game hunting]] with his wealthy friends.
